_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live squad state. Read by squad_state.py. TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md is the human narrative. Update BOTH after every actioned transfer. CORRECTED 2 Sep 2026 (live check via fpl-research MCP's get_squad, entry 1041614): bank 0.5->0.4 (the 'KNOWN DRIFT' the 28 Aug note below flagged - Sarr sold for £6.4m live, not the £6.5m this file had tracked). Also found while cross-checking: João Pedro's live price had risen 7.5->7.7 (not a Sarr-related change, a separate organic price rise), so squad_value moved 99.5->99.7 to match - the JSON's own squad_value-vs-sum-of-prices validator check requires this. Total (squad_value+bank) is now £100.1m, not £100.0m - that is correct, not a bug: a held player's price rising past what you paid means your TEAM VALUE has genuinely grown past the original £100m budget, which only ever constrained the squad at purchase time. squad_state.py's validator previously (wrongly) treated squad_value+bank>100.0 as an error; fixed the same day to check bank>=0 instead, which is the actual constraint that can never be violated.
as_at_note: GW3 pre-deadline (Fri 4 Sep 2026 17:30 UTC). NO TRANSFER this week - Sylvan's own call, holding the free transfer to bank 2 and apply as a double next week. optimise_squad.py --fixtures --transfers 1 (intel ON by default) found only Schade -> Scott at +0.11 xP/90 (+0.5 pts/5-GW hold), inside/at the noise floor, so nothing was left on the table by holding. A 2-transfer/-4 hit line (Schade+Virgil -> Canvot+Rice) was also surfaced and explicitly rejected by the optimiser's own numbers (-1.0 pts net over 5 GWs, breakeven 6.6 GWs) - not actioned. CAPTAIN CHANGED, 4 Sep 2026: Gabriel -> B.Fernandes, Sylvan's own call. captaincy_odds (with intel, neutral mode) actually had O'Reilly leading on E[pts] (6.60), P(haul) (16.0%) AND P(blank) (19.3%) - driven partly by three ROLE_INTEL adjustments fence rows (cbit90/xgi90/stp), two extended and one brand new the same morning, all Sylvan's own unsourced estimates - flagged as a real but partly model-internal edge before the decision. B.Fernandes was presented as the fully data-driven, no-ROLE_INTEL-dependency alternative: 2nd on E[pts] (5.99) with a strong P(haul) (15.6%). Vice left at Thiago (not explicitly revisited this week - note Mbeumo (5.62 E[pts]) is the model's actual current runner-up, worth a look next time the armband is revisited). NOT YET ACTIONED LIVE on fantasy.premierleague.com - squad.json/TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md record the decision; live site submission is a separate step, only done if/when Sylvan explicitly asks for it. PREVIOUS (GW2): Sarr -> Schade transfer and Gabriel captaincy, actioned live 28 Aug 2026 - see TEAM_CHANGE_LOG.md's prior CURRENT STATE section for full detail, preserved below rather than deleted.
